question: When atomWithStorage receives overlapping promised and direct updates, does final atom and storage authority follow invocation order or promise resolution order?

sources.name: Jotai atomWithStorage implementation
sources.claim: Promised updates call set(baseAtom, resolvedValue) and storage.setItem only after their promise resolves, with no invocation-generation guard.

sources.name: Owned-fork characterization branch
sources.claim: Three target-native controls characterize older promised updates against a newer direct update, reset, and promised update.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Older promised updates become final after newer operations.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Promised update authority follows resolution order; retain a finding candidate and evaluate a narrow invocation-generation repair.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Newer direct, reset, or promised updates remain final after the older promise resolves.
